constellations.name: Orion
constellations.mythology: Orion was a gigantic huntsman whom Zeus placed among the stars as a constellation after his death.
constellations.skyLocation: Visible in the eastern sky during winter evenings.

constellations.name: Ursa Major
constellations.mythology: Represented by a bear, containing the famous Big Dipper asterism.

celestialEvents.description: One of the best meteor showers producing up to 120 meteors per hour.
